_note: One rider description per class, used verbatim in create_object_state so every archetype's composite for a given class is the same figure. Kept in the repo so a later batch matches an earlier one -- two differently-worded prompts produce two different knights, and they would be visibly different mounts apart.
_suffix: rider seated on its back, legs astride, hands forward
